def factor_phase_acceleration_breakout(df):
    """Long-horizon trend phase transition: detect when price breaks above its slow trend while the slow trend itself is accelerating, capturing market expansion from consolidation into a sustained cycle upswing."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    high = df_copy["high"]
    low = df_copy["low"]

    slow_ma = close.rolling(60, min_periods=60).mean()
    fast_ma = close.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    trend_slope = slow_ma - slow_ma.shift(20)
    range_ = (high - low).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    range_ = range_.replace(0.0, np.nan)

    breakout = (close - slow_ma) / slow_ma.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    acceleration = trend_slope / range_
    factor = breakout + 0.5 * acceleration + 0.25 * ((fast_ma - slow_ma) / slow_ma.replace(0.0, np.nan))
    df_copy["factor_phase_acceleration_breakout"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_phase_acceleration_breakout"]
rationale: This factor targets a market-phase transition mechanism: long-term uptrends become more valuable when the slow trend is accelerating and price is breaking above the slow average. It is not a generic momentum stack; the signal emphasizes expansion out of a neutral phase into a sustained cycle upswing, which is characteristic of the Market Structure & Cycle layer.
